item.title: RST Supply Rilana 180F
item.excerpt:
A handmade, high end Japanese stickbait which is easy to swim. Whether you're winding, twitching or giving the lure a long sweep, the lure will swim in various conditions. 

Basic actions:

The RilaNa can be swum simply by a straight winding action.

Technical action:

  • Reeling speed variations: This lure can handle dead slow, slow, medium, and high speeds, so try varying the reeling speed throughout a single retrieve to entice the fish. Sudden changes of speed variations and pauses are also very effective.

    Example: High-Middle-Slow-Pause-Middle-Dead Slow → Middle-High-Sudden Stop

  • Reeling + Strong Jerks & Twitches: Occasionally, try making the lure slide underwater with jerks while varying your reeling speed. The key to sliding is to use stronger, more impactful short jerks than usual and make them quick! This might be difficult with a rod that's too soft.

  • Length 180 mm

  • Gr.69

nextItem.title: Hammerhead Sharapoa 250 Slim LV
nextItem.excerpt:
When tuna and GT get picky, go slim. The Sharapoa 250 Slim is what you reach for when fish are turning down your regular poppers—conditions where they’re being selective and nothing seems to work. Handmade in Japan with wood specifically chosen for proper buoyancy with heavy hooks, this popper maintains a vertical float that triggers strikes from educated fish. Rig with Decoy Y-S23 7/0 trebles for traditional setups, or run Suteki 5/0 single hooks or plugging double assist for better hook clearance and fewer tangles. The slimmer body profile mimics smaller baitfish without losing the weight needed for long casts (110g gets you the distance). Sits with the head 60-65mm out of the water. Simple deal: pressured fish, slim profile, more bites.

  • Length 250 mm

  • Gr.115
